label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Korea
items.text: Joaquin Niemann claimed his eighth LIV Golf title by winning a playoff over Talor Gooch in Busan, the most LIV wins by any player since 2022, stabilizing LIV amid Saudi PIF funding ending after 2026.

items.headline: DeChambeau’s Driving Chaos
items.text: Talor Gooch described playing with Bryson DeChambeau as “a whole different animal” due to massive galleries drawn by Bryson’s driving and social media presence.

items.headline: Potgieter’s NCAA Bogey Record
items.text: Louisiana’s Malan Potgieter extended his bogey-free streak to 91 holes at the NCAA Championship, breaking the unofficial NCAA record of 74 and approaching Tiger Woods’ pro mark of 110.
